deploy.startCommand: /bin/bash -c 'set -eu; umask 077; : "${AIOS_SANDBOX_HOST_KEY_B64:?is required on Railway: without a stable host key each redeploy breaks the Hermes known_hosts entry}"; : "${AIOS_SANDBOX_SSH_PUBKEY:?is required on Railway: the Hermes public key for authorized_keys}"; k=/etc/ssh/keys/ssh_host_ed25519_key; install -d -m 0755 /etc/ssh/keys; printf %s "$AIOS_SANDBOX_HOST_KEY_B64" | base64 -d >$k; ssh-keygen -y -f $k >$k.pub; unset AIOS_SANDBOX_HOST_KEY_B64; printf "%s\n" "$AIOS_SANDBOX_SSH_PUBKEY" >/run/aios-authorized_keys; if [ -n "${AIOS_EDGE_URL:-}" ]; then [[ $AIOS_EDGE_URL =~ ^https?://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?/?$ ]] || { echo "AIOS_EDGE_URL must be http(s)://host[:port]" >&2; exit 1; }; printf "export AIOS_EDGE_URL=%s\n" "$AIOS_EDGE_URL" >/etc/profile.d/aios-railway.sh; chmod 0644 /etc/profile.d/aios-railway.sh; fi; AIOS_AUTHORIZED_KEYS=/run/aios-authorized_keys exec /usr/bin/tini -- /usr/local/sbin/aios-sandbox-entrypoint'
